title: fix(spec): the protocol 16 → 17 upgrade rationale states each cited decision in words instead of a tracker number (stage 8)
body:
Part of #20749
Clause-②: no

Stage 8 of the `domain:spec` lane's share of the runtime-string burn-down (ruling `5902360492`, form D): the author-visible tracker ids in **step 17's** rationale in `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, per the pointer `5968465093`. Every cited decision is now stated in words, or the citation is dropped where its sentence already said what was decided. Text only. Step 18 and the test strings are later stages, so this PR closes no card.

## What changed

- **`step17.rationale`: 1 message, 116 tracker ids, 91 distinct records** (four of them in sibling repositories: one cloud card, two objectui cards and one objectui PR). The rationale is one `[...].join('')` array of string literals, and **105 of its literals** carried the 116 ids. Exactly those 105 literals changed. The array keeps its element count, and no other literal moved.
- **The one reader that matched this text by a tracker number moved with it.** `migrations.test.ts` pinned `toMatch(/#4722/)` in a test titled after that number. It now pins the rewritten words. See "Readers" below.
- **Regenerated:** `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`, through `check:generated --fix` (only `gen:upgrade-guide` was stale). Its 57 changed lines are exactly the 57 rewritten paragraphs. Nothing else prints this rationale: `spec-changes.json` does not carry step rationales and stayed up to date.
- One `@objectstack/spec` **patch** changeset, `Clause-②: no`. The rationale ships in `dist` and `os migrate meta` prints it per hop. The new text is in `dist/migrations/index.js` and `index.mjs`, and 0 dist files carry the five replaced fragments I probed.
- No step-18 text, no class (e) work beyond the moved pin, and no schema, order, id, conversion or behaviour change.

## Acceptance notes

- **One cited card was not readable from this session: cloud 910.** The REST GET answered 403 (this session has no access to that repository), and attaching the repository was refused (no access). I did not invent a decision. The sentence itself states what it relied on: the cloud runtime had stopped reading `agent.tools`. This repo records the same fact in the `agentToolsToSkills` docblock (`conversions/registry.ts`). So the number is dropped and the sentence keeps that claim, now attributed to "the cloud runtime".
- **Card 3896 has no comments, and its body is the sharing-rule criteria defect.** The rationale cites it for three later acts of that line of work. Each is read from what landed: the first full security re-verification of the liveness ledger, which found RLS `priority` void (17.0 release notes); the close-out sweep that retired fourteen inert authoring keys (changeset `12a19a8`); and the earlier removal of the plugin-runtime module's discovery and sandbox config, which left the five operation contracts for a later design call (spec CHANGELOG). The text names each act.
- **Stale-tense judgment, left as written.** The objectui paragraph ends "… drop the exemptions, the input and the dead branch on the next pin bump." Both objectui cards have since closed completed. Only the subject literal carried the ids, and it now reads "objectui's side of both rulings drops …". The tail literal carries no id, so it was not touched, and it still describes what the rulings decided.
- **Long lines.** The proof requires a fixed element count, so a rewrite that adds words lengthens its own literal. Eight literals now exceed 118 characters (the longest is 131). The repo has no `max-len` rule, and the joined text, which is what authors read, is unaffected.
- **Overlap.** `origin/main` moved five commits after the base (`55e6f14f8d` is the tip): pm tooling and skills docs. None touches this PR's four paths or `packages/spec`, so main was not merged; the merge queue rebuilds onto current `main`. Card 21464's stage 5 (claim `5975220557`) has no open PR yet, so nothing landed to merge. Of the nine open PRs, one touches `migrations/registry.ts`: PR 21668 (card 20281 stage 3). Its hunks sit at lines 8793 and 8817, inside step 18, and are disjoint from lines 111–1077 here. The changesets PR (`changeset-release/main`) only lists earlier stages' changesets.
